title: Include the withdrawal endpoint
rationale: An off-by-one interval error retains a restriction at its exact endpoint.

title: Exclude the treatment start
rationale: An off-by-one interval error allows harvest at the exact treatment start.

title: Include the administration endpoint
rationale: Administration incorrectly takes precedence at its exact end.

title: Require every active treatment to be in administration
rationale: Overlapping administration and withdrawal incorrectly select WITHDRAWAL.

title: Retain expired treatment state
rationale: A missed inspection window leaves a stale treatment or withdrawal state.

title: Remove the wintering harvest guard
rationale: A seasonal state restriction is omitted while other guards remain.

title: Throw after recording business rejection
rationale: A business rejection is represented as an unchecked exception and rolls back its audit.

title: Remove explicit per-hive write lock
rationale: Concurrent operations no longer acquire the declared common lock before assigning event time.

title: Keep nanoseconds in harvest event time
rationale: JSON event time diverges from PostgreSQL timestamp precision.

title: Omit transition event association
rationale: The transition exists but loses its relational link to the accepted command.
